content.title: Nothing but Bet: Insider Information, Organized Crime, and the Social Network Behind the 2025 NBA Betting Scandal
content.abstract: Abstract On October 23, 2025, federal prosecutors unsealed an indictment charging six individuals, including an active NBA player and a former NBA player and coach, with participating in an organized scheme that utilized insider information to manipulate online sports betting markets. The present study utilizes the federal indictment in United States v. Earnest et al. to reconstruct and analyze the social network underlying the scheme, the first major federal organized crime case of its kind since the legalization and rapid expansion of online sports betting in the United States.
